outline: 1. 傅利葉分析與訊號取樣，2. 離散時序系統之頻率響應與電路設計， 3. Infinite Impulse Response 數位濾波器設計：Bilinear 轉換式，Impulse-invariance 方式， Step-invariance 方式，高通、帶通、帶拒濾波器轉換式，4.Finite Impulse Response 數位濾波器設計：Fourier Series 方法，Window 方法，5. 離散與快速傅利葉轉換：DFT、FFT等演算法。
schedule:
Week 1: 	Introduction to digital signal processing
Week 2,3: Review of linear systems
-Overview of linear systems
-Solutions to linear difference equations
-Impulse response
-Convolution derived from linearity
-Stability issues
Week 4,5: Discrete-time Fourier transform
-Fourier transform vs. Discrete-time Fourier transform
-Properties of DTFT
-Examples & applications of DTFT
Week 6,7: Sampling and reconstruction
-Concept of sampling and aliasing
-Concept of reconstruction (Sampling theorem)
-A/D, D/A, and analog filters
-Quantization noise
-Design issues
Week 8,10,11:	Discrete Fourier transform
-DFT concept
-DFT properties
-Circular convolution
-Overlap-add (OVLA) algorithm
-FFT algorithms
-Linear convolution via FFT and OVLA
Week 12:	 Spectral analysis
-Effects of various types of windows (main-lobe/side-lobe)
-Uncertainty principle
Week 13,14: Z-transform
-Properties
-Solving difference equations via Z-transform
-Transfer function and stability issues
Week 15,16: Introduction to Digital filters
-Design of FIR filters via window method
-Concept of linear phase
-Design of IIR filters via bilinear transform
-Programming issues
Week 17 Advanced topics

Lecture notes available for students.
Suggested textbook: Digital Signal Processing, a computer-based approach, Sanjit Mitra.
Prerequisite, style of the course, and others: Any graduate student may attend this course. However, some background on signals and systems are strongly recommended. The style of this course is to emphasize the physical meaning of the math equations, instead of deriving them without explanation. A more practical approach is to be used so that students know how to apply the technology of the DPS to real-life problems.
